scenario_limit: Arithmetic scenarios hold assumed current RSS fixed for comparison; they are not a prediction of a rerun peak. Shell-balanced ranges can differ from targets; a negative AO target falls to individual shells, largest five AOs here.

unbudgeted_copy.scope: 12-double array layout discriminator only; no contractions or quantum calculation.
unbudgeted_copy.interpretation: Pinned contract line 271 evaluates a default-C reshape of reversed F-contiguous dimensions before creating an F-contiguous array. In this shape family both operations copy. During conversion the original rhok_oo, reshape copy and final copy can coexist; max_memory is not consulted.

assessment.2000MB_trial: Plausible resource-only test: lowers SCF construction/J-K blocks and gradient block targets where not floored. It cannot lower all allocations or establish an RSS bound.
assessment.spike_caveat: 4.819563 GB accounts only for three coexisting occupied/auxiliary arrays plus the metric derivative at one potential transient. It excludes existing state, live prior buffers, native workspaces, HDF5 caches, and allocator retention; it is not a measured peak or an additive RSS model. INFO-level log does not identify the allocation where the controller stopped the process.
assessment.stale_block_budget: get_jk calculates rhok_oo retrieval block size at lines171-172 before allocating the full rhok_oo at175. The AO derivative ao_ranges calculated at125-127 are reused at192 after that full allocation. Current memory is not recomputed for those extra live allocations.
assessment.floor_and_fixed_terms: Metric/factorization, rhok_oo, metric derivatives and contraction reshapes are independent of requested memory. ip1/retrieval blocks have a minimum20 auxiliary functions.
assessment.next_if_trial_fails: Retain the 8e9 RSS cap. Review bounded equivalent contraction/layout or spilling algorithms with numerical parity before changing implementation; do not repeat memory-hint trials or omit auxiliary response.
